[word/document.xml] Field execution of the rolling backdrop props relies on a coordinated division of responsibility between parent volunteers and student performers:
[word/document.xml] A. Parent Pit & Logistics Crew:
[word/document.xml] • Trailer Unloading & Staging: Offload backdrop carts from the equipment trailer and roll them to the stadium entrance tunnel or staging chute (Figure 3).

-[word/document.xml] • Ballast Loading & Verification: Place 2 to 3 double-bagged 15-lb sandbags over the 3/4" vertical retention posts on each side wing (4–6 bags total, 60–90 lbs) prior to field entrance.

+[word/document.xml] • Ballast Loading & Wind Schedule Compliance: Assess venue wind conditions and stage double-bagged 15-lb sandbags according to the Standardized Tiered Ballasting & Wind Speed Schedule (Section 1.4, Table 1.4). Under Tier 1 normal conditions (0–12 mph), place 2 sandbags over each vertical wing post (4 bags / 60 lbs). Under Tier 2 advisory conditions (12–18 mph), place 3 sandbags over each wing post (6 bags / 90 lbs). Under Tier 3 high-wind conditions (18–22 mph), maintain 3 bags per wing post and place 3 supplemental sandbags flat across the rear 2x4 rail (9 bags / 135 lbs). Never deploy backdrops if sustained winds exceed 20 mph or gusts exceed 25 mph (Tier 4 NO-GO).
[word/document.xml] • Pre-Show Safety Check: Verify all four swivel casters rotate freely, brake levers are disengaged for transit, and strut mounting hardware is secure.
[word/document.xml] • Staging Order: Arrange backdrops in numerical show drill order at the field gate.

[word/document.xml] • Exit Catch Crew: Position parent volunteers (holding official Field Pass wristbands per Rule 9.07) at the stadium exit gate to receive carts from students, assist with deceleration, remove ballast sandbags, and pack the trailer.
[word/document.xml] Rule 9.07: Parent Field Access & Wristband Limits

[word/document.xml] • 25 Field Pass Wristbands: Access to the field is restricted to Directors/Staff with CBA passes and parents assisting with props/front ensemble with designated Field Pass wristbands. Each band receives exactly 25 Field Pass wristbands upon check-in. Additional wristbands are not available.
[word/document.xml] 1.6 Post-Use Teardown and Trailer Storage
-[word/document.xml] 1. Immediate De-Ballasting: Remove all 15-lb sandbags from the 3/4" vertical wing posts at the exit chute. Never transport carts in trailers with sandbags installed on the posts.

+[word/document.xml] 1. Immediate De-Ballasting: Remove all 15-lb sandbags from the 3/4" vertical wing posts and rear framing rail at the stadium exit chute immediately following performance exit. Never transport carts in trailers or across curbs with sandbags installed on the posts or frame.
[word/document.xml] 2. Sandbag Trailer Staging: Stack sandbags low over the trailer axles on rubber floor mats to maintain a low trailer center of gravity.

[word/document.xml] 3. Cart Base Loading: Roll empty cart bases into the front trailer nose wall standing upright (Figure 4). The 3D-printed Black ASA corner bumper braces prevent scuffing between adjacent carts.

[word/document.xml] 4. Ratchet Strap Restraint: Secure cart bases using heavy-duty E-track ratchet straps wrapped around the bottom 2x4 lumber rails (Figure 4). NEVER strap across the steel pipe frame or struts.
